post_text:
Rosewood Calistoga will open on 15 April 2027 with 96 keys on 118 acres of Napa Valley ridgeline. Opening-night rates start at $2,500 before tax.

Public reservations open on 4 November. Until now, the resort could only be booked through Rosewood Elite travel advisers.

The estate is led by @Daniel Simon, Managing Director of Rosewood Calistoga and Rosewood Residences Calistoga, who arrives from Rosewood Phnom Penh. @James Tattersall, Cluster Director of Sales & Marketing for Calistoga and Rosewood Sand Hill, steers the commercial launch. In the region, @Jillian Katcher is Vice President of Operations, Americas & the Caribbean.

The design follows the vision of the late architect Ed Tuttle, carried forward by the studio Atelier Marsh. Beside the 31 suites sit 20 private villas and 13 estate homesites.

It is the third Californian address for @Rosewood Hotels & Resorts, part of the group led by CEO @Sonia Cheng.

The signal: opening to advisers first, then to the public, lets a brand set its price before the market reacts. At $2,500 a night, Rosewood is testing how high Napa's luxury ceiling can go.

Would you give travel advisers first access to a new opening?
